frequency_question: How often do state supreme courts rule to allow challenged maps under tight pre-election deadlines versus blocking them or running out the clock?
membership_rule: Includes any state supreme court proceeding where a partisan or minority-favored map was challenged and faced an administrative election deadline of 30 days or less.
